result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visual/content anomaly is a '−100%' discount badge on the pizza restaurant card, which implies a completely free order and looks like a data or calculation error. A couple of minor cosmetic points were also noted.

issues.description: The pizza card in 'Popular right now' displays a '−100%' discount badge, which suggests everything is free. This is almost certainly a pricing/data error (or a mislabeled 'free delivery' promo) and undermines user trust.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount value in the backend data. If the promo is actually free delivery, label it '€0 delivery' like the ramen card; otherwise cap or validate discount percentages so values like 100% are flagged before rendering.

issues.description: Redundant '€0 delivery' information on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card: it appears both as an overlay badge on the image and again in the metadata line below the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery indicator only once (e.g., keep the badge on the image and drop it from the metadata row) to reduce visual clutter.

issues.description: Inconsistent favorite (heart) button styling between cards: the ramen card uses a borderless white outline heart while the pizza card's heart sits in a dark translucent circle.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent heart-button treatment (same background chip and icon style) across all restaurant cards.
